items.name: Ir Musande Augustin
items.quote: Congo Developers Club has been a true accelerator in my tech journey. I learned, shared my knowledge, and met passionate people who inspired me to take my projects further. It is a community that encourages growth, collaboration, and innovation.

items.name: Ir Baraka Kinywa
items.quote: Congo Developers Club opened the door to my first professional experience at EvoluData as a junior developer. It was an opportunity that marked the beginning of my journey in tech.

items.name: Ir Lens Mutombo
items.quote: Congo Developers Club is the most active tech community in the DRC, with incredible networking opportunities.
